title: Riftn Takaddun shaida — Jagorori, Token, dApps & FAQ
description: Official Riftn takardun: dandamali overview, dApps, token tattalin arziki, staking, wasanni, roadmap, FAQ da sauransu.
body:
Duk abin da kuke bukata don amfani, haɗawa, ginawa da faɗaɗa tare da dandamalinmu. Daga jagororin farawa cikin sauri zuwa tsare-tsare na ci gaba.

Mai sauri & Amintacce

An gina a kan sarƙoƙin da suka fi aminci da sauri a cikin L1s da EVM L2s.

Mai tsaro

Masu riƙe token suna gudanar da nodes a duniya baki ɗaya don samar da cibiyar sadarwa da samun lada

Tallafin Mai haɓakawa

Muna tallafawa ayyukan al'umma da shirye-shirye inda za mu iya

Al'umma

Al'umma da aka kafa kuma mai tallafawa tun 2021

Riftn: tsohuwar intanet tana fadi. Sabon ƙasa yana tashi.
